title: scripts/verify_registration.sh: verify /proc/crypto registrations
description: Shell script that parses /proc/crypto and verifies: (1) all expected wolfkm algorithms are present (cbc(aes), ctr(aes), xts(aes), gcm(aes), ccm(aes), sha256, sha384, sha512, sha3-256, sha3-512, hmac(sha256), hmac(sha384), hmac(sha512), cmac(aes), stdrng, rsa, ecdh-nist-p256, ecdh-nist-p384, dh); (2) each has priority 300; (3) each has a wolfkm driver name. Exits 0 if all pass, exits nonzero with diagnostic output if any fail.
design: Parse /proc/crypto by splitting on blank lines (each algorithm is a stanza). For each expected algorithm, grep for 'name.*: <algo>' then check that the same stanza contains 'driver.*wolfkm' and 'priority.*300'. Color output: green PASS, red FAIL. Called by tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh as the first integration check after module load.
